scope: Generic native-lost-participant evaluation only: +200 for lost registered opponent, -200 for lost ally. Current game terminal win/loss scoring and starting all-alive scores remain unchanged. No card-name heuristics.
line_endings: Baseline preserved byte-for-byte from native4932. Modified source explicitly UTF8/LF, after confirming the only baseline preparation difference was CRLF normalization. New class family must be compiled and tested; no executable class equivalence is assumed.
